assets.purpose: Three illustration panels: treasure, ruins, race
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-quality painted illustration atlas for an existing Vietnamese xianxia game's Activities modal.
The user's supplied interface references are STYLE AND COMPOSITION guidance, not an edit target. Generate original artwork for the LEFT illustration of the three activity tabs. NO UI, NO WORDS, no lettering, no labels, no border, no logos, no watermarks.
Composition: a clean TRIPTYCH, exactly THREE equal-width vertical paintings side-by-side in ONE landscape image, 3:2 overall ratio (ideally 1536x1024), each panel a tall portrait. Each panel occupies exactly one third with no gutters or seam ornaments. No subject may cross into an adjacent third. All three panels can be cropped individually in code. Detailed hand-painted 2.5D fantasy game key art, crisp central subjects, deep midnight teal, blue magical light and luminous gold. Each panel lower and outer edges naturally fade into deep dark teal (#031922), so it blends into a game card; preserve full readable subjects.
LEFT THIRD: “Thiên Giáng Dị Bảo”: a magnificent gold treasure chest resting on a jagged floating stone ledge, brilliant vertical golden beam descending from the heavens to the chest, curling gold energy rings and few sparks, imposing blue mountain silhouettes and sea of clouds. Strong warm gold focus, chest centered at 60% height, plenty of heavenly sky above, absolutely no people or text.
CENTER THIRD: “Động Phủ Viễn Cổ”: enormous ancient blue glowing circular stone portal engraved with delicate runes, ruined Chinese temple gate, stone steps leading to the portal, cavern and abyss waterfall in the foreground, atmospheric cyan magical light, dark indigo and teal rock. Portal centered at 48% height and fully visible. Mysterious, intricate, monumental, not horror.
RIGHT THIRD: “Ngự Kiếm Vượt Thiên Quan”: white-and-blue robed black-haired cultivator seen from behind at lower left, full body STANDING ON A BLUE FLYING SWORD, flying toward luminous gold checkpoint rings among tall floating islands, tiny pagodas, white waterfalls, blossom trees and bright blue misty skies. Sword visible under the character's feet, both legs visible. Flowing robes, graceful flight, adventurous airy mood. Do not show combat or a handheld sword.
Keep all critical subjects away from the outer 8% of each panel. These are illustration assets only; application code supplies all Vietnamese text and controls. Opaque painted backgrounds, no transparency needed.

assets.purpose: Gold dragon and cloud modal border
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent ornate UI FRAME for a Vietnamese xianxia game Activities modal.
Generate ONE landscape rectangular frame with a TRULY TRANSPARENT empty interior. 3:2 overall aspect, ideally 1536x1024. The center 80% MUST be empty transparent, no painting, no tint fill, no checkerboard. No text whatsoever.
Look like a premium Chinese cultivation RPG UI: fine luminous antique GOLD filigree with dark jade enamel details, gold dragon head and sweeping long slender horns curling along the upper left edge, elegant flowing gold/cloud ornaments on the upper right edge, layered swirling gold clouds at the lower two corners, thin double gold rules on the straight sides. At top center, a modest ornamental blank dark teal nameplate with a small jade lotus crest above, suitable for code-rendered text “Hoạt Động” but DO NOT render any words. This nameplate may occupy the central 30% of width and the uppermost 13% of image. Keep left and right 4% border thin; at bottom corners ornament extends to 9% of height. No tabs, no buttons, no icons, no close glyph, no people, no scenery. Smooth refined hand-painted game UI detailing, strong silhouette, avoid overloaded tiny curls. Frame hugs the perimeter with 2% outer transparent padding, its large inner opening must remain transparent. Preserve actual alpha, not a painted transparency pattern.
